# conan

<!-- The reference table below this banner is regenerated by `make generate`. Handwritten prose below the table lives in internal/support/prose/. -->

This page explains how Bomly builds a dependency graph for `conan` projects: the detector chain it runs, what that chain needs, and what it can report.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package manager | `conan` |
| Ecosystem | `cpp` |
| Detector chain | `conan-detector`, `syft-detector` |
| Evidence patterns | `conan.lock`, `conanfile.txt`, `conanfile.py`, `conaninfo.txt` |
| Multi-module resolution | No |
| Install-first support | No |
| Remediation hints | None |
| Commands the chain may run | `conan`. The Syft fallback is built in; the lite build runs an external `syft` from `PATH` instead. |
